timingDefinition.start: Adapter monotonic timer immediately before turn/start RPC
timingDefinition.end: Root turn/completed notification observed by adapter
timingDefinition.includes: Model turn, tool work, documentation reads and self-tests within that turn
timingDefinition.excludes: CLI startup, subscription/config/tooling preflight, post-turn service checks, output drain/shutdown, independent acceptance and Lighthouse
timingDefinition.notDerivedFrom: finished_at minus started_at; finished_at is recorded after post-turn shutdown
timingDefinition.consistency: Same timing boundary and field for every application in all six frameworks
